ability.name: Illusion
ability.note: When this Pokémon is on the bench or has not yet engaged in its first battle after moving to the field, and another of your Pokémon - that has the same MP or less than this Pokémon and has not yet engaged in its first battle after moving to the field - is attacked, before the battle, that Pokémon may switch places with this Pokémon.

wheel.name: Crosscounter
wheel.note: *If the battle opponent spins an Attack of 110 damage or higher, the battle opponent is knocked out instead of this Pokémon.

wheel.name: Night Daze
wheel.note: *In the battle opponent's next battle, that Pokémon's White Attacks become Misses.
